learning_outcomes.text: Explain the microservices architecture and when it is and is not appropriate
Identify service boundaries using domain context
Choose synchronous vs asynchronous communication patterns
Manage data per service and reason about eventual consistency
Design an API gateway and client-to-service communication
Address cross-cutting concerns: resiliency, health and observability

integrative_case: Decompose a monolithic ordering application into microservices: define boundaries from the domain, choose HTTP for queries and an event bus for cross-service updates, give each service its own data store, place an API gateway in front, and add health checks and retries.
